custom_groups.name: Red-green screening
custom_groups.about: Ishihara / CVTME vanishing plates: red, orange and red-purple on yellow-green to blue-green. Protan and deutan, ~8% of males, ~0.5% of females.

custom_groups.name: Transformation
custom_groups.about: Inverted plates: unsaturated blue-green and yellow-green on red-orange. Protan and deutan, ~8% of males, ~0.5% of females.

custom_groups.name: Protan vs deutan
custom_groups.about: Ishihara plates 26/27: purple-magenta (protan line) and red (deutan line) on neutral gray. Protan ~2%, deutan ~6% of males.

custom_groups.name: HRR protan
custom_groups.about: HRR: unsaturated red and cyan on neutral gray. Protan, ~2% of males.

custom_groups.name: HRR deutan
custom_groups.about: HRR: green and magenta on neutral gray. Deutan, ~6% of males (the most common deficiency).

custom_groups.name: HRR tritan
custom_groups.about: HRR: blue-purple and yellow-green on neutral gray. Tritan, under 0.01%, males and females alike.
